name: SMB owner-operator
pitch: Speak what you would say over the counter.

profile.goals: Stay visible to local customers without hiring a marketer. Post useful, friendly updates that sound like me talking in the shop.
profile.projects: Weekly offers, behind-the-scenes, customer tips, community shoutouts.
profile.brand_voice: Warm, plainspoken, owner-operator. Short sentences. No corporate fluff. Talk like I would over the counter.

traits.target_audience: Local customers and neighbors who already know the brand as a person.
